annotations.annotation_text: Page 306 opens Book 2, Chapter 2 ("The Night Lessons") during the Age of Heroes phase. This passage continues the children studying the Trivium and Quadrivium, Dolph and Kev drawing geometric diagrams of ALP's body, marginal glosses and footnotes, featuring Shem (Dolph), Shaun (Kev), Issy (footnotes). The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.

annotations.annotation_text: Issy/daughter figure "daughter" on page 306 ("The Night Lessons"): the narcissistic mirror-daughter, modeled on Isolde and Swift's dual muses Stella and Vanessa, appears here within the children studying the Trivium and Quadrivium, Dolph and Kev drawing geometric diagrams of ALP's body, marginal glosses and footnotes. Her prismatic splitting into twenty-eight Rainbow Girls reflects the cycle's Age of Heroes phase through youthful seduction and self-reflection.

The Age of Heroes dream-logic transforms ordinary syntax into a palimpsest of global literary and mythic references.
